# NEW 2026-11-17 conquest campaigns (phase 1 + 2). Generated by gen_heg_campaigns.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_hc_egypt = {
    monthly_spawn_chance = 1
    # Started only by oe_hc_egypt_start (activate_situation); ends once the campaign is over and is activated again
    # by the next campaign. Without can_end the engine ends a situation at once (tested 2026-11-17).
    can_start = { always = no }
    can_end = { NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } } } }
    visible = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } }
    # The monthly tick runs from monthly_country_pulse (situation on_monthly did not fire in testing).
    map_color = {
        if = {
            limit = { oe_hc_egypt_location = yes has_owner = yes owner = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
            value = rgb { 214 168 74 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_hc_egypt_location = yes has_owner = yes owner = { oe_hc_egypt_target_active = yes } }
            value = rgb { 150 60 50 }
        }
        else = { value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR }
    }
}
